name: scikit-learn
description: scikit-learn is the leading Python library for machine learning, offering a consistent API for classification, regression, clustering, and dimensionality reduction. Originally developed at INRIA, the French national research institute, it is the foundational ML toolkit for the Python data science ecosystem.

owner.name: scikit-learn community
owner.description: Open-source community maintaining the scikit-learn Python ML library, with roots at INRIA France.
